properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.config.path.linux
properties.description: Path to the application's own config file when running on Linux, supporting {HOME}/{NAME} format specifiers.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.config.path.darwin
properties.description: Path to the application's own config file when running on macOS, supporting {HOME}/{NAME} format specifiers.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.config.path.win32
properties.description: Path to the application's own config file when running on Windows, supporting {HOME}/{NAME} format specifiers.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.config.default-repo-path
properties.description: Default dotfile repository path offered by `init` when the user doesn't supply one or accepts the suggested default.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.config.default-allow-post-install
properties.description: Default value for the allow-post-install-scripts config flag written by `init` when `--allow-post-install-scripts` isn't given.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.dotfile-glob-pattern
properties.description: Glob pattern used to locate `.dotfiles` marker files within the dotfile repository.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.version
properties.description: Application version string reported by the CLI's `--version` option.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.subprocess.timeout
properties.description: Maximum time, in milliseconds, to wait for a subprocess to finish before it is forcibly killed.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.post-install-glob-pattern.linux
properties.description: Glob pattern used to locate post-install scripts within the dotfile repository when running on Linux.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.post-install-glob-pattern.darwin
properties.description: Glob pattern used to locate post-install scripts within the dotfile repository when running on macOS.

properties.name: spring-dotfile-manager.post-install-glob-pattern.win32
properties.description: Glob pattern used to locate post-install scripts within the dotfile repository when running on Windows.
